value: The automated-access rule above applies to every AI provider and agent, including OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPTBot, Operator), Anthropic (Claude, ClaudeBot), Google (Gemini, Google-Extended), Microsoft (Copilot, Bing AI), Meta AI, Amazon (Alexa, Amazonbot), Apple Intelligence (Applebot-Extended), Perplexity, xAI (Grok), Mistral, Cohere, ByteDance (Bytespider), DeepSeek, Common Crawl (CCBot), and any AI agent, agentic browser, or coding agent acting for a person or a company, whether or not it identifies itself: each may read the public pages to answer questions, and none may use Union Ground content for training or datasets without written permission.
